purpose: Stable test contract for the normal-token Review Ready publisher.
dispatchRoute: gh workflow run linktrend-review-ready-publisher.yml -f branch=<branch> -f sha=<sha> -f action=<publish|withdraw> -f dry_run=<true|false>
withdrawRoute: gh workflow run linktrend-review-ready-publisher.yml -f branch=<branch> -f sha=<sha> -f action=withdraw -f reason=<reason> -f dry_run=<true|false>

validatorPublicApi.cli: python3 scripts/gitops/review_ready_dispatch.py validate --branch BRANCH --sha SHA [--dry-run BOOL] [--evidence-path PATH] [--evidence-json JSON] [--github-repository OWNER/NAME] [--repository OWNER/NAME] [--issue-number N]

evidenceValidation: completion_gate.validate_evidence against immutable requested SHA (workflow publish step)
remoteTipValidation: workflow verifies GitHub branches API tip == requested sha
rules: Trusted scripts checkout must use github.event.repository.default_branch with persist-credentials: false.
Issue branch/SHA may be checked out as data only under a separate path.
Branch must match issue/<number>-<slug> (lowercase slug); reject refs/heads/ and protected branches.
completion_gate / readiness_status emit normal-token dispatch routes only for verified issue/<number>-<slug>; legacy allowlist branches get migration remediation.
SHA must be full 40-char hex; reject abbreviated SHAs and mutable refs.
Evidence headSha must equal requested sha; schemaVersion>=1; commands exitCode 0.
repository must match GITHUB_REPOSITORY when provided (no cross-repo publish).
Privileged publish uses documented AUTOMATION_TOKEN in a trusted publisher context; GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN are aliases with AUTOMATION_TOKEN precedence. No human-token fallback.
LINKTREND_TRUSTED_REVIEW_READY_PUBLISHER=1 belongs only on the publish/withdraw step.
GitHub App IDs, private keys, and token-mint actions are forbidden.
Fail closed when the trusted flag, token, permission, immutable identity, or evidence is absent or wrong.
One-time v2.3.8 bootstrap must not call the defective predecessor publisher.
